summary: Infobird Co., Ltd, a Hong Kong-based foreign private issuer, furnished a Form 6-K on September 24, 2026, reporting interim results for the six months ended June 30, 2026. Exhibit 99.1 contains unaudited interim condensed consolidated financial statements; Exhibit 99.2 contains management's discussion and analysis of financial condition and results of operations. No transaction, tender, strategic review, activist stake, or special-situation event is disclosed; the filing is a routine semi-annual reporting obligation under Rule 13a-16. The report is signed by Chief Financial Officer Yiting Song. No deal terms, board recommendation, or advisor is referenced.
